[[Standard hour/Legends|Hours]] after [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] forces fought in a [[Taking of Kuat|battle]] at [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]] in [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], which resulted in a New Republic victory, undercover Imperial [[Agent/Legends|agents]] '''attacked''' the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] of [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]]. These agents triggered explosives that ripped through the docks, and activated the [[Aurora (Star Dreadnought)|''Aurora'']]{{'s}} and ''[[Stellar Halo]]''{{'s}} [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]], sending them into [[Kuat (star)|Kuat's sun]]. The agents also abducted key KDY designers and fled to the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]] aboard the half-complete [[Eclipse (Eclipse-class)|''Eclipse'']].
